sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 15 September 2025, pitch SYN-SYNCP000090-P1 was put before Silver Oak Medical Group 090 on behalf of SANOFI.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a group service charge of 1.5 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a Influenza preferred-position minimum of 50 per cent in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer came back with a counter.
